title: Psilocybin versus Personalized Neuromodulation for Resistant Depression (PSILO-MODULATION)
official: Advancing PRecise Interventions for resistant DEpression: rebalancing brain networks and investigating the trajectories of antidepressant effect with psilocybin and personalized neuromodulation (PRIDE)
summary: Main objective: Compare the effectiveness of psilocybin and personalized rTMS in Treatment Resistant Depression (TRD)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age between 18 and 65 years
2. Diagnosis of TRD: subjects with a MDD diagnosis, non-responders to at least two antidepressant medications at adequate doses administered for adequate time (i.e., 4-6 weeks)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Presence of severe organic/neurological comorbidities
2. Previous episodes of seizures
3. Substance use disorders
4. Cognitive decline
5. Psychotic disorders
6. Pregnancy/postpartum state
